old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-v6f0","title":"LinkLayer receipt clock can self-assert and retain a forged trusted timing domain","description":"Fresh final timing security review: LinkLayer.__post_init__ accepts an arbitrary receipt_clock callable plus caller-supplied receipt_clock_domain, so an attacker can pair lambda:0 with a trusted MonotonicClock.domain_identity and pass DioTimeVerifier domain checks. LinkLayer is also a mutable dataclass: object.__setattr__(link, _receipt_clock, attacker_callable) rebinds timestamps while _clock_domain remains trusted, and newly authenticated DIO time samples use attacker-selected observation times. Require an exact immutable MonotonicClock-like capability owned as one binding, derive domain only from it, reject self-asserted overrides/bare mismatched callables, and detect/fail closed on rebinding. Add construction, post-construction, active tracker, mutation race, and legitimate fake-clock tests.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T09:21:32.621929Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T09:21:32.621929Z"}
